Messages.Author: Reyda
Messages.Body:
Hi !
a guy from my playgroup told me that, when the game comes down to two
players remaining, you have an alternative at discarding your misdirecion
and deflections : just play them, and announce that "the vamp bleeding me is
now bleeding me". In fact the "corrected" card text is barring this.
--
Deflection [Jyhad, V:TES, SW] Cardtype: Reaction
Cost: 1 blood ; Discipline: Dominate
Only usable when you are being bled. Tap this reacting vampire. Choose
another Methuselah other than the one controlling the minion bleeding you.
The acting minion is bleeding that Methuselah. (S) As above, but do not tap
this vampire.
--
I've already have the same feeling with "my enemy's enemy", but the point to
play those card that way is... Only to cycle, which can be crucial when
we're only 2 meths lefts. So can i play multiple "my enemy's enemy" on a
single bleed action with different untapped vampires ? and which are the
cards you can play this way ? And if you decline to block, see a nasty
modifier coming, can you play one of those cards to give you another
opportunity to block ?
i klnow it sounds stupid but i promised to ask.

thanks for your patience.

reyda

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <9g6f05$416$1...@hadron.noos.net>, Reyda <re...@noos.fr> writes

>a guy from my playgroup told me that, when the game comes down to two
>players remaining, you have an alternative at discarding your misdirecion
>and deflections : just play them, and announce that "the vamp bleeding me is
>now bleeding me".

They were corrected to prevent this.

This stops decks becoming "abusive" by over-loading on them - because
they jam your hand when you get down to two players.

--
